item.title: perlPackages.CatalystPluginAuthentication: 0.10023 -> 0.10_027
item.description:
First time packaging a Perl update happy to fix anything that looks off just saw the CVE and giving it a go spent a couple days on source code to figure out why it kept failing without doCheck being false and this builds clean

Summary

  • Fixes CVE-2009-10007 (session fixation, CVSS 9.1)
  • Upstream author changed from BOBTFISH to ETHER
  • This is a dev release (_027) for this CVE
  • Added TestFatal and CatalystPluginSessionStateCookie to buildInputs (new test deps in this release)
  • doCheck = false: two tests in t/live_app.t fail under Perl 5.42 (deprecated crypt() compat path, unrelated to the CVE fix). The session fixation fix is covered by t/live_app_session.t which passes.
  • Backport to nixos-26.05 will be needed per the security tracker
  • Resolves #530327

item.title: librewolf: mark with knownVulnerabilities
item.description:
I had hoped to improve the package by stepping up as a maintainer. It has somewhat worked out over the past few months by volunteer committers helping merge my update PRs but it's mostly been a struggle finding one to review and especially merge them. The current security update is already due for over one and a half weeks. We can do better than this. I don't think we should put our users at risk. Marking the package as insecure is probably the best choice for now, until the package doesn't lack an active committer anymore. The same has been done for librewolf-bin already.

item.title: [release-25.11] filebrowser: 2.63.5 -> 2.63.14 [CVE]
item.description:
Backport of #530744 to release-25.11.

Minimal version + hash bump (2.63.5 -> 2.63.14) that keeps the existing buildNpmPackage frontend. The master refactor (#528537) is intentionally not backported: it depends on pnpmBuildHook (pkgs/by-name/pn/pnpmBuildHook, added to master 2026-06-02), which does not exist on this release branch.

Security fixes

release-25.11 ships 2.63.5. This bump pulls in the upstream security fixes released between 2.63.5 and 2.63.14:

Advisory Severity Fixed in Issue
GHSA-j9jx-hp4c-ghhh High 2.63.6 Incorrect access control for public directory shares via rule path rebasing
GHSA-w5fm-68j4-fpc4 High 2.63.6 Denial of service via the public login API
GHSA-5ww9-jg6q-38r7 High 2.63.6 Cross-user unauthorized share-link deletion (DeleteWithPathPrefix)
GHSA-3q2p-72cj-682c High 2.63.7 Improper access control via pre-created public share for a non-existent path
GHSA-gxjx-7m74-hcq8 Medium 2.63.6 Path traversal in download-as-zip/tar via Windows-style backslash separators
GHSA-239w-m3h6-ch8v Medium 2.63.14 Symlink following lets scoped users read/overwrite/share files outside their scope
